messages:
maya: Quick heads-up: per-unit cost card in Console shows inflated costs when cached responses are returned. Anyone else seeing this?

yang: Yeah, saw that on a tenant earlier. Console seems to be reading gross token counts but not subtracting cache credits.

phil: Do we have a repro tenant/timeframe?

maya: tenant T123, route /billing/summary, last_7d. Console: model=redwood-7b cost=$42. Ledger shows 300k gross tokens, cache credits 120k but UI still billing on 300k.

sarah: Likely the join issue I mentioned last sprint. cache_credits are separate rows keyed by invocation_id, but our dashboard join to token_ledger isn't deduping by inv_id+variant. Quick SQL: `SELECT inv_id, model, sum(gross) gross, sum(cache_saved) cache, sum(gross)-sum(cache) net FROM token_ledger LEFT JOIN cache_credits USING (inv_id) GROUP BY inv_id, model` needs schema alignment.

devex: Reminder of the API shape debate: return net_tokens from telemetry vs return gross + cache_credit and let Console compute. UX wants both (gross + credits) so users can drill into "why".

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out metric fix to staging at 1712065000  monitor staging dashboards.

maya: If Console computes net, we need a stable contract: fields gross_tokens, cache_credit, cache_origin (prefix/kv/prefetch), model_sku, and routing_path. Also attribution for multi-model chains (first-owner vs pro-rated).

yang: Also routing policy matters: sticky vs variant-fallback changes who gets the cache saving. Add cache_origin + routing_path tags.

phil: UI suggestion: tooltip on cost card "net = gross - cached_prefix - kv_cache" + link to docs for attribution. Helps support triage.

sarah: I'll draft telemetry schema and example payloads. Propose POST /internal/telemetry/invocations with fields=gross_tokens,cache_credit,cache_origin,model_variant,routing_path. Will raise PR.

maya: Thanks. Can someone run the SQL on last_30d and share diffs? Yang?

yang: On it. Will share results this afternoon, watch for weird prefetch credits.

phil: +1 to locking contract first. We can't flip semantics mid-rollout.

maya: I'll file a Console bug with repro steps and link this thread. Thanks!
